title: A hot laptop throttles: master status and Workers show the reading and the halved trial cap
description: GY-3416: with a fixture hwmon reporting package 95C and core 96C against a 105C critical — a reading the guard once compared to its own crit-3 (102C) and never held — the limit is min(85C, crit-3): master status carries the hottest package or core sensor (96C) and the trial cap halved from 4 to 2, holding no launch since GY-3501, and the Workers page shows the same two beside the sessions.
